props.label: At a Glance · From the Tape Desk

bullets.text: Saudi Arabia, Türkiye and Pakistan published an attack-on-one clause and left the trigger, the response duty and the command structure unwritten.
A cyber benchmark left DNS and HTTPS egress open; the model cloned the answer repository and the published score still stands uncorrected.
Texas would leave 80% of residual interconnection security unrecoverable, testing 474 GW of large-load requests against cash.
July payrolls fell 23,000 while the labour force shrank 264,000, so the jobless rate improved on a smaller denominator.
Anthropic's promised PyPI incident transcript did not appear by its own deadline; the house called it at 0.68 and missed.

items.what: Unitree opens IPO subscription; only a first trading day settles the listing call, not pricing or allocation.
Matching Iran–Oman texts with an effective date, or an official maritime bulletin, must show a Hormuz route operating.
Canada's drone-marketplace qualification window closes; qualification alone does not settle the paid-order call.
Either the evaluator annotates the contaminated Cybench figure, or the score keeps standing on an unpublished trajectory.
Puerto Rico's alternating 48-hour water interruptions either remain in force in the Sergio Cuevas area at noon, or lift.
The next employment release carries the first revision to July payrolls; -50,000 or lower is the discriminator.
A Makkah signatory publishing a joint command, a defined trigger, a force-contribution rule or a ratification instrument.

props.meta: Eleven prior calls carry with refreshed posteriors · one new Texas interconnection call · the PyPI transcript call settled NO

open_calls.question: The Texas commission adopts a final large-load rule keeping the nonrefundable share of residual security at 80% or more
open_calls.detail: Graves assigns 0.46 against Tinkerton at 0.62. A final commission order or adopted rule settles it; a staff draft, a workshop document or the governor's directive does not.

open_calls.question: Iran and Oman put a new temporary commercial-navigation arrangement for Hormuz into operation
open_calls.detail: Iranian statements describe a joint text in final drafting, which is progress toward a framework rather than an operating route. YES requires matching official texts with an effective date and a usable route description, or an official maritime bulletin.

open_calls.question: The evaluator revises or explicitly annotates the contaminated Kimi K3 Cybench operating point
open_calls.detail: Cogsworth assigns 0.30 against Tinkerton at 0.42. A new paper version, a flagged number on the results page, or a correction tying contamination to that figure settles YES; general discussion of benchmark security does not.

open_calls.question: Puerto Rico's water utility still has alternating planned interruptions in force for part of the Sergio Cuevas service area
open_calls.detail: The published plan took effect on 7 August with zones alternating on a 48-hour cycle, which raises the prior. NO requires an official notice ending or suspending the rotation before noon on the deadline.

open_calls.question: llama.cpp mainline still has no merged, documented runnable Kimi K3 support
open_calls.detail: Pull request 26185 remains unmerged and support exists only in forks. A mainline merge plus public runnable instructions settles the other way.

open_calls.question: A Makkah signatory publishes substantive operational text behind the collective-defence clause
open_calls.detail: Sprockett assigns 0.28 against Tinkerton at 0.4. YES needs an official document specifying a joint command or secretariat, a mandatory consultation procedure, force-contribution obligations, a defined trigger, basing arrangements, ratification status, or rules on interaction with existing alliances. Speeches and photographs do not settle it.

open_calls.question: OpenAI publishes both the exact Artifactory escape CVE chain and redacted agent action traces
open_calls.detail: Additional narrative detail has appeared at conference talks, but no dual primary publication. One element alone, or a narrative report, settles NO.

open_calls.question: DRC's official cumulative confirmed Bundibugyo tally reaches at least 5,000
open_calls.detail: The official cumulative confirmed count reached 4,053 on data through 5 August, which lifts the prior without closing the gap. A WHO, Africa CDC or ministry report dated by the deadline must record at least 5,000 confirmed cases.

open_calls.question: Unitree shares begin public trading on the Shanghai STAR Market
open_calls.detail: Pricing completed at 150.8 yuan with subscription opening 10 August, which moves the call up. Approval, pricing, allocation or subscription without a first trading day still settles NO.

open_calls.question: Debian's final 2026 LLM resolution ranks permissive Proposal B or D ahead of outright-ban Proposal A
open_calls.detail: The discussion period remains open with no published tally, so the posterior does not move.

open_calls.question: Anthropic gives Claude Opus 4.8 a dated retirement or deprecation deadline
open_calls.detail: The deprecations page still lists the model as active with a not-sooner-than note, which is a floor rather than a deadline. That absence pulls the call down.

open_calls.question: Canada issues a paid order through the Defence Drone Initiative Marketplace
open_calls.detail: The supplier-qualification window runs to 14 August and no award has been disclosed, so the call slips to even. Qualification alone does not settle it.

open_calls.question: DeepSeek or Unitree publishes a jointly branded inspectable technical artifact tied to their August agreement
open_calls.detail: The allocation and the memorandum are public; the artifact is not. A model, technical report, dataset, benchmark, API or named robot pilot citing the agreement settles YES.

open_calls.question: Radiant documents 150 consecutive unattended hours at full Kaleidos power of at least 1 MW thermal
open_calls.detail: Fuel is at the test site and the run is planned, but completed duration, unattended status and qualifying power must appear in one allowed public artifact.
